sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Jodi A. Frost.
Jodi A. Frost is listed as a records specialist in the latest available Transparent Utah records for fiscal year 2026.
She is married to American Fork Mayor Bradley J. Frost.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Transparent Utah records list Jodi A. Frost's work for American Fork from fiscal year 2020 through 2026. The latest listed position is Records Specialist.
These years are based on reported pay, not exact hire or departure dates. Records through 2026 suggest continued employment, but do not confirm current status.

Her marriage to Mayor Brad Frost makes the hiring and supervision process relevant to public accountability. It is worth asking who selected her for the job and whether the mayor had any involvement in hiring, pay, supervision, or discipline. The relationship itself does not establish that she received special treatment.
